title: Eaton Intelligent Power Manager mc2 Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Eaton Intelligent Power Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within system_srv.js. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root on Linux or SYSTEM on Windows.
